description: This file defines the LeaveCommentAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing comments on leave requests within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It includes methods for listing all comments for a leave, adding a new comment, and internal validation and access control logic.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for handling leave-related comments, supporting listing and creation of comments, with validation and access control.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazy initializer and getter for the LeaveRequestCommentService instance.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the leave ID from request URL parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all comments for a specific leave, with support for pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new comment to a leave, performs validation, access checks, and saves the comment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Shared validation rules, mainly ensuring leave ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: setLeaveComment
methods.description: Populates a LeaveComment object with data from request and context (author, timestamp).

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Persist a LeaveComment object via DAO.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; method stub throwing exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; method stub throwing exception.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the leave's comments; throws ForbiddenException if not.
